name: M01 — Preserve design intent independently from execution scope
use_when: Whenever a broad project is reduced to a sprint, proof, MVP, repair, application demo, or bounded executable slice.
content:
[User direction, 2026-10-27] Recover the initial inspiration, aesthetic/specification, story, features, services, tokens, integration ambitions, and constraints. Carry them forward with the experience earned through implementation.

[Proposed operating rule] Maintain three linked records: the full design/product horizon; the evolving design/engineering contract; and the current execution envelope. A slice proves a selected claim. It must declare which larger intentions it preserves, temporarily approximates, defers, contradicts, or cannot address. Passing the slice does not certify the horizon; narrowing a slice does not erase it.

Retain an origin dossier: source/reference region, authored intent, desired affect, user/task, narrative arc, material vocabulary, visual hierarchy, interaction grammar, feature graph, product/service model, constraints, and source rights. Include alternatives and unresolved interpretation. Do not force every artistic intuition into a physical/scientific assertion.

At the end of a sprint, review both correspondence and engineering. Did the material still feel like the original inspiration? Did the important action still work? What became simpler? What was lost? Was that loss temporary, accepted, or unnoticed? A feature is deferred only with a reason and a re-entry condition. A diagram or CI slice must not quietly replace a sensory product.

[Check] A future collaborator should be able to explain what the full project aims to become, what is real now, why the current slice was selected, and how it returns value to the larger direction using the saved records alone.

name: M02 — Art direction and accessibility as parallel design work
use_when: When specifying a visual family, composing screens, reviewing fidelity, or designing mobile, static, muted, high-contrast, and low-motion alternatives.
content:
[Recovered pattern] Several families seek material behavior, authored texture, and responsive light. Their meanings differ. FLORÉ's impasto is not AURELITH's nacre; Kozo's paper is not MÄG-RISO's print shop; ChromaFlora's state arc is not a generic motion preset.

[Proposed contract] Define each family's recognizable invariants at microtexture, mesostructure, component, composition, scene, and narrative scales. Specify silhouette, palette relationships, typography roles, depth/light, grain direction, spatial rhythm, transition character, and negative constraints. Record which are functional, expressive, physical approximations, metaphors, or culturally attributed.

Compose a reference/implementation board for actual use: reference regions → extracted relationships → candidate mechanism → current render → what changed. Evaluate hierarchy, material specificity, motion continuity, emotional register, task completion, and sensory burden. Human art direction remains an explicit judgment, not a fake numeric fidelity score.

Fallback is a parallel authored expression: remove motion while retaining staging and state; reduce transparency while keeping surface hierarchy; mute while preserving meaning; replace gyro with direct controls; offer a list alongside a spatial atlas. Input semantics and readable content survive quality changes.

[Check] Review one meaningful flow in its full and accessible expressions. It must look intentional in each, preserve all decisions, and retain its family identity. Browser/device tests and human visual review establish different parts of that judgment.

name: M03 — Tokens and parameters: typed, scoped, and bound to behavior
use_when: When translating art direction into CSS/JSON/Figma tokens, GLSL uniforms, motion, sound, textures, or manufacturing parameters.
content:
[Proposed model] Separate primitive values, semantic roles, family material recipes, component state bindings, contextual profiles, and user overrides. Use a pinned published DTCG exchange format where appropriate, with richer domain metadata in a documented extension or adjacent parameter registry. The published 2025.10 report is a Community Group specification; do not call a preview draft or a generic “W3C format” a W3C Recommendation.

Each parameter needs identity, owner, interpretation class, unit/type, range/default, interpolation, dependency, effect, consumer, fallback, and evidence. Physical constants, authorial controls, symbolic mappings, performance tiers, accessibility choices, and machine/process settings must remain distinguishable.

A unit conversion is explicit: milliseconds ↔ seconds, degrees ↔ radians, CSS pixel ↔ canvas/NDC with declared frame/DPR, sRGB ↔ declared working color, optical thickness with units. Do not normalize nanometers to an arbitrary 0–1 value and still imply unchanged physics. An acoustic absorption coefficient is not optical roughness.

Every advertised control needs an active consumer and an observable effect. Track token → runtime parameter → shader uniform/function → evidence. Missing and unsupported bindings should be diagnosable. Recompute styles on meaningful configuration changes; do not read computed styles continuously in an animation loop by default.

[Check] Sweep range endpoints, invalid values, unit conversions, theme changes, and a coupled pair. Verify the intended output and reject prohibited combinations. In the current Wildfire sample, only animation speed is consumed by the sampled shader; film-thickness support elsewhere must be established separately.

name: M04 — Stack and function boundaries for living creative instruments
use_when: When selecting frameworks/libraries or implementing UI, shaders, 3D, animation, texture, audio, inference, and exports.
content:
[Observed estate] The recovered projects already use several viable runtimes: browser-native HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas; Vite/React tools; Astro/React Mochi; Next/React/R3F applications; Python/offline generation; and proposed WASM/worker compute. No single framework is canonical for the whole estate.

[Proposed selection rule] Keep a working native instrument when that best serves it. Use React/Vite for application-oriented authoring; Next where its routing/server/content model is actually used; Astro for content-led shells with deliberate islands. Do not combine frameworks because each appears in a source list. A shared domain kernel can outlive any shell.

Use one writer for each animated property. CSS can own ordinary visual transitions; Motion can own component gestures/state; GSAP can own authored timelines. An adapter can coordinate them, but they must not compete over transforms or time. Separate canonical time/simulation from display refresh and adaptive quality.

Proposed specialized functions—not claims of existing exports—include registerSource, extractVisualObservations, proposeMechanisms, defineMaterialRecipe, compileTokenBindings, resolveInteractionProfile, deriveRenderPlan, renderSpecimen, evaluateCorrespondence, packageExport, recordDecision, and restoreCheckpoint. Each accepts typed input and returns an inspectable result with limits. Subjective interpretation stays a candidate until an authorized decision.

Textures need structural fields, UV/object-space conventions, transfer functions, normal orientation, tiling rules, bit depth, and provenance. Prefer a standard physical material for supported behavior and targeted operators for a specific missing mechanism; keep a reference-render lane when realtime shortcuts cannot answer the question.

Inference adapters own model/version, input recipe, privacy, candidate outputs, errors, budget, and provenance. They do not mutate canonical design meaning or fabricate successful assets.

[Check] A real input can travel through one mechanism into two presentation adapters without silently changing identity, units, behavior, or rights.

name: M05 — Environment and configuration: recover names without inventing deployment
use_when: When preparing setup instructions, .env.example, external-service adapters, deployment, device qualification, or portability.
content:
[Observed code references] Artisan Solutions Hub references DATABASE_URL, AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_API_KEY, and AI_INTEGRATIONS_OPENAI_BASE_URL. The latter two belong to its recorded Replit integration environment; do not assume they exist outside it.

[Specified in AETHER handoff, deployment unverified] NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, AETHER_LICENSE_SECRET, OG_GENERATION_TOKEN, and optional GUMROAD_WEBHOOK_SECRET. These are proposed configuration names from a handoff, not recovered live credentials or a complete deployed contract.

[Proposed configuration discipline] Document each variable's consumer, purpose, exposure, required/optional state, validation, and example placeholder. Browser-public settings are public: VITE_* and NEXT_PUBLIC_* values are bundled for their respective client builds. Service-role/provider/webhook/signing credentials stay on an appropriate server/worker boundary. Public client configuration still requires correct server/database authorization.

Do not use environment variables for every artistic control. A material preset, motion profile, narrative state, replay seed/time, and quality choice belong in explicit versioned runtime records when they need inspection, portability, or user editing. Use environment config for deployment/service addresses, capabilities, and protected integration settings.

[Proposed names, not existing project variables] A public asset base, public inspector toggle, server artifact directory, inference backend URL, or dry-run policy may be useful, but choose repository-specific names only after identifying a real consumer. A client-side flag is not execution authorization.

Record Node/package manager/runtime/OS/browser/GPU, lockfile, renderer version, capability checks, and failure fallback. Windows/WSL, Android/Termux, and headless CI are different environments; a pass on one is not a hardware claim about another.

[Check] A clean checkout starts in documented local/mock/dry-run mode, reports missing capabilities accurately, and never announces an unavailable service as successful. No actual environment values were harvested for this recovery.

name: M06 — Repair immaturity through observable state and correspondence
use_when: When a component looks finished but is incomplete, a workflow is premature, a runtime claim outruns evidence, or a prototype is being productized.
content:
[Proposed maturity record] Track specification, source presence, runtime behavior, interaction/accessibility, integration, visual correspondence, reproducibility, device qualification, and product/service operation separately. These dimensions do not form one automatic ladder. A shader can compile yet look wrong; a beautiful view can have dead controls; a passing core can lack a usable product.

For components, cover default, hover, focus, press, selected, disabled, loading, success, error, empty, permission-denied, unsupported, cancellation, disposal, and restoration as relevant. A real state has a trigger, transition, ownership, visible/assistive feedback, side effects, fallback, and observable check.

For flows, distinguish a real action, a local simulation, a generated candidate, and a planned integration. A booking form, checkout label, source export button, save icon, or solver URL must not imply a successful external outcome without an actual result.

[Concrete repair queue] Mochi: native disabled/keyboard/cancel/cleanup/preset parity. FLORÉ: named motion calibration and typography drift. ChromaFlora: channel matrix and build authority. Wildfire: real parameter consumption and appearance labeling. Design Fusion: demo unlock versus payment entitlement. Lumina: validated process invocation and real output checks. Ritual Geometry: lifecycle vocabulary reconciliation. Artisan: product identity and genuine-versus-concept evidence.

[Check] Each repair has a small failure-demonstrating example and a clear observable success condition. The repair is not marked complete until executed and reviewed. This recovery specifies resolutions; it does not claim those code migrations have happened.

name: M07 — Integration without flattening product identity
use_when: When composing repositories, extracting shared packages, making plugins, or deciding whether two similar projects should merge.
content:
[Proposed ownership map] Keep appearance standards, optical mechanisms, material semantics/provenance, and cross-repository governance with their established authorities, subject to current-source reconciliation. A consumer does not become an authority by copying code.

Preserve product roles: Shader Gallery researches and demonstrates; AETHER packages adoption; Wildfire connects tokens and renderer/UI consumers; FLORÉ composes editorial identity; Mochi investigates/reuses tactile behavior; Kozo and MÄG-RISO are distinct authored worlds; Ritual Geometry owns authored motif families; Omni-Loom is a later fabrication consumer; Kinexus is a proposed translation workspace.

These are proposed integrations drawn from recovered roles, not proof that packages already interoperate. Before extracting, require a stable interface, an actual producer, a real consumer, an independent test, a version/license, and a fallback. A second consumer can justify generalization; it should not be invented just to create infrastructure.

Keep semantic interpretation, cultural authority, narrative state, physical constants, and local view arrangement separate. Shared infrastructure should reduce repeated mistakes, not require every family to adopt the same palette, layout, spring, or governance screen.

[Check] An integration can be removed or replaced without erasing source identity, breaking accessible task completion, or silently migrating accepted meaning. Every boundary records conversion and evidence loss.

name: M08 — Sprints that restore ambition and produce visible progress
use_when: When selecting the next sprint, recovering stale repositories, writing a handoff, or preparing portfolio/product proof.
content:
[Proposed sprint model] First recover the original reference and full product story. Then select a meaningful demonstrator that visibly carries the project's identity. Pair it with the smallest engineering repair that makes that experience real. Close with correspondence review, technical evidence, and an updated horizon record.

A useful first recovery wave is FLORÉ's named motion/component-state surface; Mochi's button/spring semantics; Wildfire's token-control specimen; Design Fusion's honest demo/commercial boundary; and Lumina's solver/output boundary. Art direction happens within each, not after an unrelated technical sprint.

A second wave can connect one material recipe across Shader Gallery → a qualified consumer, restore one Kozo journey with real assets, and complete a MÄG-RISO proof/export flow. NACRE//ARCHIVE and AETHER then have something truthful and useful to package. Kinexus remains a proposal until its identity and one real plugin seam are established.

These are candidate priorities, not a new fixed schedule or authorization to change every repository. Preserve other horizons and let concrete opportunity/user needs alter ordering.

Every handoff carries intent retained, source refs, exact revision, allowed changes, desired visual example, relevant tests, failure behavior, evidence, open decisions, and re-entry conditions for deferred work. No one should have to reconstruct the project from an old chat and scattered ZIPs.

[Check] At sprint close there is a visible artifact, a clear explanation of its value, verified behavior appropriate to its claim, and an updated record of what remains.

name: D01 — AURELITH: computational luxury as an interface language
use_when: When designing AURELITH surfaces, premium interfaces, editorial product experiences, material tokens, or cross-system adaptations.
content:
[Recovered intent] The May 2026 technical specification describes software with the authored presence of an optical instrument: cinematic framing, sculptural silhouette, layered nacre, pearl resin, opaline highlights, directional reflections, liquid-enamel settling, and deliberate grain. Its dark-primary editorial register is specific; it should not become the default appearance of every MelodicBloom project.

[Design DNA] Preserve atmospheric/deep/content/float layers; pearl #F6F1EB and opaline cyan #BDF7F4; primitive → semantic → component token aliases; fluid serif display with readable sans UI; density as a spatial context. PEARL, VISCOUS, CRYSTALLINE, NACRE, and ORBITAL were named motion characters. The source defines a full interaction graph, luminous keyboard focus, non-color state cues, and a materially authored reduced-motion experience.

[Observed boundary] The specification is evidence of intent, not proof that lint enforcement, AAA contrast, or every surface behavior exists. The client deck repeats it and adds commercial promises; that descendant is not independent implementation evidence.

[Repair resolution — proposed] Replace blanket rules such as mandatory spatial movement or four layers in every view with task-scoped material contracts. Immediate actions and accessible reading must remain prompt and legible. Keep the artistic hierarchy; let low-motion, reduced-transparency, mobile, and dense work contexts change delivery without erasing identity. Contrast claims require testing against the actual composited background.

[Reimagined horizon] A coherent atelier-grade interface library with a material inspector: show each surface's construction, token lineage, motion profile, accessibility alternative, and rendering cost. Services can include visual-language reconstruction, flagship interface implementation, and stewardship; pricing/licensing remain proposals.

[Carry-forward test] One card, one field, one dialog, and one editorial composition must retain recognizable material character across default, keyboard focus, disabled, loading, touch, reduced motion, and reduced transparency. This demonstrator supports the broader language; it does not redefine the language as four components.

name: D02 — AURELITH: live audiovisual instrument, separate from the design language
use_when: When recovering AURELITH's audio-reactive engine, performance installation, multitouch controls, stage integrations, or runtime architecture.
content:
[Recovered intent] A separate AURELITH document imagines a somatic audiovisual instrument: multitouch controls, audio analysis, deforming shader fields, off-thread computation, state relay, and eventual MIDI/OSC/Art-Net stage interaction. This is a different product context from the AURELITH CSS design language even though they share a name.

[Design DNA] The performance surface should expose playable controls, signal flow, scene transitions, and intentional audiovisual coupling. Light, deformation, and timbre express the same gesture while preserving a meaningful mute/static mode. A performance instrument needs reliable interruption and recovery as much as spectacle.

[Observed boundary] The architecture compilation claims zero GC overhead, measured low latencies, uninterrupted audio, enterprise readiness, and stage interoperability without accompanying raw test receipts in that document. Preserve these as historical assertions/targets, not achievements. The word thermodynamic in its state vector does not establish a measured physical model.

[Repair resolution — proposed] Split input normalization, canonical control/state timeline, audio rendering, graphics, telemetry, recording, and external transport. AudioWorklet is an explicit audio execution boundary; a generic Worker is not itself an audio output engine. Shared-memory operation needs a qualified environment and a message-based fallback. Network/stage adapters are separate capability-bearing services, not assumed direct browser powers.

[Reimagined horizon] A playable, recordable visual instrument and installation toolkit. Presets carry signal mappings, safe sensory limits, timing policy, quality modes, and provenance. Hardware integration can return later through a simulator and observable loopback before a real venue.

[Carry-forward test] Replay one recorded gesture sequence at multiple display rates; verify the same semantic events, bounded audiovisual timing, mute/reduced-motion operation, safe disconnect, and recovery. No fixed latency promise until hardware measurements exist.

name: D03 — NACRE//ARCHIVE: a constructed material and product world

content:
[Recovered intent] NACRE//ARCHIVE's granular production handoff defines a material grammar of shell, lace, lacquer, pearl, gold, paper, flower, city, and myth. It explicitly resists becoming a loose collection of pretty AI portraits. Construction is the identity: shell forms anatomy, lace carries layered memory, gold articulates contour, parchment carries archival context.

[Product and narrative] The Five Rooms landing concept leads to MASK, BLOOM, ATLAS, TEXTURES, and MOTION; the fuller taxonomy also includes CUTOUT and UI. Reconcile marketing navigation with artifact taxonomy rather than deleting branches. Preserve hero → room exploration → artifact inspection → kit contents → clear offer, with a gallery, cutout builder, product ladder, and case-study trail.

[Assets and tokens] Maintain microtexture, mesostructure, and macrocomposition separately. A cutout needs intact lace, translucent petals, clean edge color, useful scale, transparent output, and tests on contrasting backgrounds. Image, prompt recipe, material annotations, license, and derivative exports belong together.

[Observed boundary] The document proposes a free sampler, Gumroad Creator Kit, Pinterest discovery, Behance case study, and later Etsy/Creative Market/Figma/POD branches. Price bands and six-month schedules are historical proposals, not sales or validated economics. Platform file limits need refresh at publishing time.

[Repair resolution — proposed] Separate the visual canon, production pipeline, product catalog, and distribution adapters. Do not require a storefront backend before the assets pass utility/fidelity checks. Preserve a real downloadable sample and truthful preview of exactly what a buyer receives.

[Reimagined horizon] A living material archive whose artifacts can become imagery, editorial covers, motion, collage elements, UI surfaces, and eventually textile repeats. Custom identities and interactive systems emerge from this grammar with explicit adaptation boundaries.

[Carry-forward test] One artifact travels through canonical artwork, usable cutout, texture crop, editorial application, and accessible web presentation with identity, provenance, and rights intact.

Formal similarity must not imply historical derivation or cultural association. Preserve contradictions as assertions with scope.

[Reimagined horizon] A queryable design-memory system that explains why a choice fits, what it may become, what must survive translation, what changes across scale, and what evidence is still missing. It can support callable design objects and Kinexus without becoming a second hidden source of truth.
